subject: Geopolitics
title: Friendly Middlemen Nations
description: A micro-lesson that makes Friendly Middlemen Nations usable.

hook.text: Russian oil flows to India at a discount. India refines it and sells products to Europe. The sanction is bypassed.

buildup.text: Neutral nations act as middlemen, buying sanctioned goods and re-exporting them. They profit from the gap.

discovery.text: Turkey, UAE, India, and Singapore all serve as evasion hubs. Their legal systems tolerate the gray zone.

twist.text: Sanctioning the middlemen risks alienating important neutral partners. The US needs India's cooperation elsewhere.

climax.text: Middlemen nations expose the core problem: sanctions need universal buy-in, but self-interest is universal too.

punchline.text: Every wall has a door if you find who sells keys.

quiz.question: Why are middlemen nations difficult to stop?
options: They have nuclear weapons as deterrence
Sanctioning them risks alienating important partners
